narrative.title: The Sensor Feed Translator
narrative.scenario: A fleet of sensor controllers emits commands operator-first, but the diagnostics dashboard only accepts operator-last feeds. The translator walks the command string backwards, keeps partially assembled feed fragments on a rack, and on each operator concatenates the two rack-top fragments with the operator moved to the end.
narrative.inputFormat: A string expression in valid prefix form with single alphanumeric operands.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the equivalent postfix (Reverse Polish) expression as a string.
constraints: Operands are single letters or digits
The expression is guaranteed to be a valid prefix expression

testCases.explanation: Each backward step relocates its operator to the tail of the two fragments it joins.
The two-operand minimal case: operands first, operator last.
